name: NitroFusion2 Fast
summary: One-step photorealistic text-to-image with NitroFusion2 W6A8 GPTQ and the shared Qwen3-4B FP8 encoder.

source.notes: Tested Cloud9 gfx1103 native ROCm, 1024x1024 portrait in 105.28s. PedroMarinhoDev W6A8 GPTQ quantized denoiser + existing Z-Image Qwen3-4B FP8 text encoder and ae VAE. Original BF16 encoder exceeded host memory guard; FP8 substitution is necessary. Quality baseline Z-Image 8 steps remains available.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: A photorealistic still life of a small red espresso cup on a white stone countertop beside a warm croissant, morning window light, realistic porcelain and flaky texture, editorial food photography.

credits: W6A8 GPTQ compressed weights by PedroMarinhoDev, same ComfyUI native architecture
FP8 Z-Image text encoder/VAE reused; avoids model weight duplication and memory overflow on Cloud9.
